prompts.siege: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production source sprite sheet for BULLETS OF FURY — OVERDRIVE, an elaborate 16-bit arcade vertical/top-down shooter. The supplied Phoenix spaceship is a STYLE/MATERIAL reference only. New original HEAVY SIEGE TANK for Juggernaut and Phoenix, inspired by the brutally wide, low, dual-cannon Harkonnen Devastator silhouette from Dune 2000. A formidable tank, not a spaceship: very wide segmented track pods, chunky blackened steel armor, riveted beveled plates, two massive short parallel main barrels on one independently rotating turret, squared rear engine vents, strong small-scale silhouette. Four-column by TWO-row sheet, exactly EIGHT equal isolated 384x384 cells on a 1536x768 transparent canvas. No drawn grid, no text, no labels, no background, no cast shadow. Every vehicle faces due NORTH (up), exact straight top-down orthographic camera, symmetrical left/right, no isometric or frontal perspective. Use compact hard-edged 16-bit pixel-art clusters, dark outlines, crisp metal highlights, restrained surface detail. Base pilot-color plates are BLUE/cobalt so later masked palette swaps can preserve steel. Tiny furnace-orange vents are a separate fixed color. Row 1 left to right: (1) fully assembled tank as concept reference; (2) complete HULL with tracks, armor and circular turret socket but NO turret or barrels, same overall hull scale as cell1; (3) detached entire twin-barrel turret alone, same scale as its appearance in cell1, turret's rotation hub centered at local 192,224 and barrels forward; (4) damaged hull with tracks and exposed turret socket, no turret, no fire/smoke, same scale as cell2. Row 2 left to right: (1) burned destroyed hull/wreck with broken tracks, no fire or smoke; (2) independent left track module alone at same scale, running upward; (3) independent right track module alone at same scale, running upward; (4) detachable twin-barrel turret in full recoil pose, exact same turret geometry as cell3 row1, barrels retract 12 pixels, no muzzle flash. Every object fully contained in its own cell with broad clear transparent gutters. Keep the turret socket of hulls at local 192,224. No spaceship wings, no logos, no lettering, no extra objects. Clearly modular usable parts with consistent scale. Match the reference's industrial arcade identity while making the pixel clusters much more compact and genuinely 16-bit.
prompts.assault: Use case: stylized-concept. New original modular ASSAULT TANK sprite sheet for Bullets of Fury — Overdrive. Reference sheet defines materials, shading and modularity, NOT the tank silhouette. This is the compact medium tank used by Axel, Cole, Decker, Maverick, Freezer and Yuri. Inspired by BattleTanx's chunky M1A1 arcade tanks: long low sloped wedge hull, narrower proportions than reference siege tank, single large long main gun with square muzzle brake, squat polygonal rotating turret, small coaxial gun, rugged rubber/steel tracks, compact rear engine grilles and futuristic side armor. Cobalt BLUE pilot-color armor panels over dark neutral gunmetal, tiny fixed amber lamps. Genuine crisp 16-bit pixel art with visible economical clusters, no smooth photorealistic rendering. Camera exact overhead orthographic, every part faces NORTH. Produce eight parts in exactly four equal columns by two equal rows on a wide transparent sheet. Each cell has generous empty transparent margin of at least 30 pixels; no part touches another cell or canvas edge. No text, labels, grid, shadows, or effects. All parts consistent physical scale. Row1: 1 complete assembled tank, 2 complete hull with tracks and circular turret socket but no turret or weapon, 3 detached complete single-gun turret at same scale as assembly, 4 damaged turretless hull with tracks. Row2: 1 burned wreck hull without flame/smoke, 2 isolated left track module, 3 isolated right track module, 4 exact same detached turret in recoil pose with barrel shortened backward slightly and no flash. Turret pivot in each turret cell is in the lower middle, allowing the long north-pointing barrel to fit. Hull sockets central and obvious for later alignment. No extra objects, no space wings. Distinct speedier rectangular main-battle-tank silhouette with beveled front armor, mechanically plausible.
prompts.panzer: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a modular sci-fi PANZER TANK sprite source sheet for Bullets of Fury — Overdrive. Reference spaceship supplies the black steel, copper edges and blue accent 16-bit arcade shading style ONLY. Tank shape must be distinct: a long narrow angular Panzer-inspired hull, flat broad side skirts covering the upper tracks, clearly rectangular rear engine deck with twin circular fans, slanted glacis nose, polygonal hexagonal turret, one long precision gun with a double-baffle muzzle brake. This is the tank family for Falva, Lizzie, Hotwire. Tough military machine without gender ornamentation. Original fictional vehicle, no insignia/logos/lettering. All repaintable armor panels COBALT BLUE; mechanical parts neutral dark steel and small fixed amber lamps. Straight overhead orthographic top-down, face NORTH, no isometric perspective. Hard pixel edges and economical clusters, authentic 16-bit arcade sprite treatment. Wide transparent sheet, exactly four columns by two rows, eight separate components, clear gutters and 40px empty outer margins. Row1: 1 complete assembled tank; 2 complete turretless hull with tracks and skirts and visible circular central turret socket; 3 complete detached turret and long cannon alone, matching its assembled scale; 4 damaged turretless hull with one cracked side skirt, no fire/smoke. Row2: 1 burnt wreck hull; 2 separated left track module with its straight armor skirt; 3 separated right track module with skirt; 4 detached recoil turret with barrel pulled back slightly but same turret body and scale as row1 cell3. Every cell faces up and has a full uncut object. Design must read as a Panzer with clean slab side skirts, long slim hull, octagonal turret and prominent long muzzle-braked cannon; avoid bulbous monster-tank silhouette. Transparent alpha, no ground, no cast shadow, no background, no labels.
prompts.tankFx: Use case: stylized-concept. A transparent pixel-art EFFECTS sprite sheet for Bullets of Fury — Overdrive ground tanks. Authentic 16-bit arcade shooter art, crisp small pixel clusters, hard edges, bright luminous cores with small controlled transparent fringes. EXACTLY 6 columns by 4 rows, 24 isolated square cells in a landscape sheet, every effect fully inside its cell with very wide clear gutters. No text or labels, no tanks, no weapons visible, no background or cast shadows. All forward firing effects point NORTH/up. ROW1 SIX PROJECTILES in order: 1 small pointed brass tank shell upright, 2 larger orange-hot armor-piercing round upright, 3 short silver rocket with orange exhaust upright, 4 heavy twin-cannon plasma shell with white-gold core upright, 5 small rifle tracer upright, 6 double-baffled golden bullet streak upright. ROW2 SIX MUZZLE-FLASH ANIMATION FRAMES: one common muzzle root at bottom-center of every cell; 1 tiny ignition, 2 short cone, 3 broad flash star, 4 longest northward blast, 5 fading orange tongues, 6 small dissipating gray smoke. Consistent root and sequence. ROW3 SIX IMPACT ANIMATION FRAMES centered at exact center each cell: 1 white spark, 2 bright yellow compact shock, 3 orange fragmentation burst, 4 expanding orange-gray blast, 5 gray-brown smoke with fragments, 6 fading sparse debris and smoke. ROW4 SIX LARGE TANK-DESTRUCTION ANIMATION FRAMES centered each cell: 1 bright core, 2 compressed circular yellow-orange fireball, 3 maximum broad red-orange fireball with gray outer smoke, 4 collapsing fireball surrounded by dark smoke, 5 gray billowing smoke clearing in middle, 6 dissipating smoke and a few embers. Top-down explosions, not side-view mushroom clouds. Clear temporal progression. No whole-sheet background glow. Separation between cells is fully transparent. No stage scenery.
prompts.infantryBase: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original transparent source sprite sheet with FOUR helmeted soldier archetypes for Bullets of Fury — Overdrive, a 16-bit top-down run-and-gun action game with Contra/Super C overhead-stage readability. The referenced Phoenix portrait gives only the rugged armored jumpsuit vocabulary. All characters wear full helmets with dark opaque visors, full boots and gloves; no visible face, no bare skin, no lettering or badges. Same cobalt blue repaintable suit/armor regions, charcoal undersuit, silver mechanical trim, tiny fixed amber visor glint. Compact realistic arcade human proportions, NOT chibi, not bobbleheads, not modern photoreal sprites. Crisp intentionally chunky 16-bit pixel clusters. Exact layout FOUR columns by TWO rows, eight isolated sprites with generous transparent gutters. Columns are 1 Juggernaut: massive broad muscular heavy-armored body, thick neck/shoulders; 2 Axel/Phoenix shared athletic male soldier, broad but substantially smaller than Juggernaut; 3 Falva/Lizzie/Hotwire shared athletic female soldier, practical fully covered armor and narrower torso; 4 regular male soldier for Cole/Decker/Maverick/Freezer/Yuri, medium lean military build. ROW1 all four in overhead view facing NORTH/up, aiming a compact black rifle up, shoulders/back and helmet top visible, feet visible behind; ROW2 the exact same four in overhead view facing SOUTH/down, rifle held downward, top of helmet and visor visible. True top-down 70-to-80-degree overhead camera used in Super C overhead stages, NOT eye-level front portraits and NOT isometric. The standing bodies are strongly foreshortened and occupy a compact footprint. Each body about 60 native pixels tall scaled up in the sheet. Every entire weapon and boot remains in cell. Transparent background absolutely no scenery, shadows, glows, text or extra objects.
prompts.supplies: Use case: stylized-concept. Original 16-bit top-down ground supply sprite sheet for Bullets of Fury — Overdrive. Industrial futuristic armored supply boxes matching an arcade alien-base infiltration game, crisp economical pixel clusters and strong dark outlines. 6 columns by 3 rows, 18 isolated objects with roomy transparent gutters on transparent background. Exact top-down/slightly overhead arcade view consistent on every item; no isometric diamonds. Row1 in order: 1 closed heavy weapon crate with bold embossed gun pictogram on lid; 2 same crate open with dark interior; 3 destroyed crate fragments; 4 ammo crate closed with three brass cartridge pictograms on lid; 5 same ammo crate open with visible cartridge tray; 6 broken ammo crate. Row2 in order: 1 loose rifle ammunition magazine stack with brass tips; 2 three shotgun shells; 3 small silver-and-red rocket bundle; 4 luminous cyan energy battery; 5 pair of heavy brass tank shells; 6 small red grenade pair. Row3 in order: 1 pick-up assault rifle; 2 pick-up wide spread-shot weapon; 3 pick-up compact rocket launcher; 4 orange boot/speed-up token in a small armored octagonal base; 5 cyan radar/sensor power-up token in same base; 6 violet magnetic power cell in same base. Crates gunmetal with thick corner braces, warning-yellow/orange edges, clear lid pictograms; open and broken states match their intact form. Pickups readable in 24 to 32 native pixels. NO medkits/healing, no armor pickups, no text, no letters, no numbers, no ground, no cast shadow, no background lighting. All distinct shapes fully contained in their cells.
prompts.godBurst: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent 16-bit arcade VFX sprite sheet for the NEW element G.O.D Burst (Godly Over-Powered Destruction) in Bullets of Fury — Overdrive, awarded from expansion level 5 boss. It is particle/atom splitting plus overwhelming magnetic energy, not ordinary fire/lightning. Visual vocabulary: bright pearl-white particle nuclei, electric-cyan thin atom-wave rings, violet magnetic field loops, small golden particles. Clean dark gaps preserve readable atomic geometry; no solid giant white screen. Exactly SIX columns by THREE rows, 18 isolated equal square cells, generous transparent gutters, each effect centered at same local center. No text, no UI, no planets, no ground. ROW1 six-frame CHARGE sequence: 1 a white seed with two tiny cyan orbit particles; 2 three tiny curved orbital trails; 3 two oval violet magnetic loops around nucleus; 4 three sharper crossed orbital loops gathering inward; 5 tight bright nucleus with compressed loops; 6 near-critical white nucleus with a visible split down center, particles held in magnetic coils. ROW2 six-frame BURST sequence: 1 nucleus forks into two brilliant particles; 2 short cyan-violet radial atom-wave; 3 concentric thin rings expand with white particle sprays; 4 maximum magnetic shock ring with asymmetric arcs and outward gold particles, hollow center; 5 thinner larger fading rings; 6 sparse fading cyan/violet particle arcs. ROW3 six individual projectile/impact components: 1 small north-pointing atomic bolt; 2 double splitting north-pointing particle bolt; 3 small magnetic hit spark; 4 clean hollow circular magnetic ring; 5 one horizontal atom-wave crescent; 6 a compact stable atomic core icon without border. Top-down effects, readable at 96px native cell size, hard-edge pixel clusters and restrained bright halos. Fully transparent outside the small effects. NO scene-wide glow, no labels.
prompts.godBurstClean: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a very clean compact 16-BIT top-down shooter atomic/magnetic effect sheet for G.O.D Burst, Bullets of Fury — Overdrive. EXACT 6 columns x 3 rows, 18 distinct sprites. Transparent background. Each effect occupies ONLY the central 55 percent of its cell, surrounded by a huge perfectly empty transparent moat on every side. No effects touch or overlap other cells. No stippling, no multicolor noise, no glassy textured blobs. Minimal sharp pixel clusters and clean lines: pearl white nuclei, cyan wave arcs, deep violet magnetic loops, a few pale-gold sparks. Limited palette, hard arcade pixels. Row1 six charge frames, centered: tiny seed; seed plus two orbits; three elliptical orbits; compressed magnetic coils; bright compact core; visibly splitting twin core. Row2 six discharge frames, centered: two separated nuclei; short atomic radial burst; small expanding hollow cyan ring; larger hollow cyan/violet ring with white particle spikes; thin dissipating open ring; only four faint arc fragments. All even largest rings remain smaller than 60% of cell width and height. Row3: one tiny north-pointing particle bolt; a northward forked twin bolt; small atomic hit sparkle; a clean hollow violet magnetic ring; a single horizontal crescent atom-wave; a stable nucleus with two orbiting electrons. Ring centers are transparent, most cell pixels fully transparent. No text, no label, no decorative border, no background light, no solid clouds. Generate all18 effects cleanly separated, each same center in its cell.
prompts.heavyActions:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a consistent top-down 16-bit run-and-gun ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for the FIRST column: massive Juggernaut heavy soldier, extremely broad armored shoulders and heavy boots of the supplied reference sheet. Use ONLY this ONE archetype throughout, preserve its helmet, proportions, armor panels, blue palette, charcoal undersuit, black rifle and dark visor. The reference gives canonical identity; do not include the other archetypes. FOUR columns by SEVEN rows = exactly TWENTY-EIGHT equally sized cells. Tall sheet. Clear 20% transparent cell gutters, no labels/grid/text/scenery/shadows. Authentic compact 16-bit arcade pixel art with economical hard-edged clusters. Fixed high overhead camera, foreshortened top-down shooter figures, never eye-level side-view/platformer sprites. Full helmet always on; no visible face or skin. Rifle aims in direction of facing, no muzzle flashes because they are separate effects.
ROW1 four standing aim directions in this exact order NORTH/up, EAST/right, SOUTH/down, WEST/left.
ROW2 four consecutive RUN-NORTH frames: left foot forward, passing, right foot forward, passing; body planted around same central anchor, clear foot/leg changes.
ROW3 four consecutive RUN-EAST frames at fixed overhead view, rifle points east, clear alternating foot stride.
ROW4 four consecutive RUN-SOUTH frames at fixed overhead view, rifle points down, clear alternating foot stride.
ROW5 four frames of ROLL-EAST evasive dodge viewed overhead: 1 drop right shoulder/tuck rifle close, 2 body rolled onto shoulder with back visible, 3 compact tucked ball with boots over hip, 4 low kneeling recovery facing east. A real somersault/shoulder roll, not four jogging poses.
ROW6 PRONE aim poses NORTH, EAST, SOUTH, WEST: body flat on belly, elbows down, rifle forward, legs stretched behind, long low silhouette visibly distinct from standing.
ROW7 four death frames no blood: recoil backward after hit, falling, landed, motionless armored body. Keep weapon and all limbs inside every cell. All sprites same anatomical scale; pose extent may change but don't zoom each frame. No background lighting or diffuse glow. Genuine alpha transparency. This is an art candidate sheet for later runtime hookup.
